resources.string: The archive starts with its first record. Dates are observation times, not exact change times. Only small photos downloaded during normal use enter the gallery.
This profile’s biography and avatar archive will be deleted and archiving will stop. Other profile observations are kept.
The archive could not be saved or read. The previous record was kept.
The archive limit was reached. Older records are kept; clear the archive to make room.
No photo has been archived yet. Unavailable older photos cannot be reconstructed.
No new records are captured while archiving is paused. Existing records remain available.
Up to %1$d changes and %2$d thumbnails per profile. The archive has a total 1.8 MiB budget and uses Keystore encryption; rolling observation limits do not erase it.
